scope: Independent read-only reanalysis of supplied V46 development evidence; not new localization performance
important_limits: Zero transport mean does not mean zero probability under the error model
Half-speed safety rescues are local feasibility checks, not better localization
V46 results did not exercise V47 branch coverage
M1 has an exact collinear invariant-subspace limitation
Equal left/right EIG does not imply zero EIG
Raw data and unpublished manuscript are not uploaded to this public code branch
